evidence: The strict artifact schema is now applied before inventory comparison, so identity-free, malformed-file, wrong component/target/builder, and null-entrypoint manifests fail instead of being accepted as empty inventory.
A real frozen executable still runs from an isolated temporary directory with PATH reduced to Windows System32 and no Python location; it returns the typed configuration-valid projection.
The exact 31,567,646-byte artifact contains 644 inventoried regular files, and the full service and desktop profiles rebuild and validate it from the clean commit.

Six focused packaging tests cover the real frozen build, Pythonless-path execution, manifest identity/schema rejection, inventory mutation/missing dependency boundaries, and exact-report hardlink denial without modifying the linked target.

The canonical report path is inspected with lstat, rejects redirects and non-private hardlinks, and is published using the repository's locked guarded atomic JSON writer to deny parent relocation, temporary tampering, and post-replacement substitution.

Recursive executable-archive inspection proves both Pydantic mypy integration modules are excluded. The required internal Pydantic Settings provider registry module is documented precisely rather than misrepresented as external YAML support.

The nine-file incremental base-to-remediation range contains only the immutable original evidence, recorded review transition/generated planning views, build contract/schema/ADR, build tool, and its packaging regression tests.
No application implementation, UI reference, dependency lock, service API, or later supervision behavior changed. Both full required verification profiles pass at the exact clean candidate.

The shipped artifact passes security policy without exceptions. The four exact time-bounded build-environment license reviews remain unchanged, and the pre-existing Node/Tauri blockers remain unsuppressed for later capability qualification.
